question: Does causally observed early holder concentration among regular wallets add signal-quality information beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: sum(amount_percentage^2) across GMGN Top100 holder rows with addr_type=0, using total-supply shares; addr_type=1 burn/dead and addr_type=2 exchange/DEX/pool are excluded
feature_contract.denominator_policy: amount_percentage remains share of total supply; never rebase to tradeable float
feature_contract.ambiguous_addr_type_policy: any returned holder row with missing/unknown addr_type makes the feature MISSING
feature_contract.missing_percentage_policy: any included regular-wallet row with missing/non-finite/out-of-range amount_percentage makes the feature MISSING

acquisition.source: GMGN OpenAPI through gmgn-cli token holders

directional_read.next_step_if_sufficient: mechanism/robustness review then define/freeze a separate fresh-confirmation hypothesis
directional_read.next_step_if_insufficient: report insufficient sample; do not extend/repeat based on observed outcome
